'''Hivestone Debris''' is a metal-like block that can generate as part of parasite-made structures and [[Meteor|Meteors]].  It must be mined with a stone pickaxe or higher.

== ''Usage'' ==
Smelting '''two''' Hivestone Debris into a furnace produces one [[Hive Scrap]].

There are also decorate slab and stair variants of this block.
